_comment: Promotion patch-panel. SAFE BY DEFAULT: master.armed=false → dry-run mirror only (no real orders, ever, until you set armed=true AND run live_promote.py --execute). mode: off|manual|auto. auto uses group/promotion.py (gated: needs >=20 resolved bets, +P&L, sane Brier). pin: team name for manual mode. Per-slot fuses: max_bet ($/order), max_open (positions), fuse_per_cycle ($/cycle). Master: daily_cap_dollars across all slots; kill cancels/blocks all.
